tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check **/*.ts && deno check **/*.tsx
tasks.start-all: deno task build-spa --watch --sourcemap=inline & deno task start
tasks.bootstrap: mkdir -p static/vendor/bootstrap static/vendor/bootstrap-icons && curl -L https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.7/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css -o static/vendor/bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css && curl -L https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.13.1/font/bootstrap-icons.css -o static/vendor/bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.css && curl -L https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.13.1/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff -o static/vendor/bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.woff && curl -L https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.13.1/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2 -o static/vendor/bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.woff2 && sed -i 's|url(../fonts/|url("./|g; s|\?.*\")|")|g' static/vendor/bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.css
